incoming.name: Red Panda
incoming.excerpt: The term fire-fox, as used to describe the Red Panda, has been propagated by its use as the logo for the web browser Mozilla Firefox.

outgoing.name: Europe
outgoing.excerpt: Europe, according to a study released by the firm XiTi on 2006- 06-16, generally had higher percentages of Firefox use, with an average of 20%.

outgoing.name: Microsoft
outgoing.excerpt: In August 2006, Microsoft made an offer to Mozilla to help integrate Firefox with the forthcoming Windows Vista, which Mozilla accepted.
